extra.summary: Discover the UOB PRVI Miles Card, your ultimate travel companion! Earn up to 8 miles for agoda & Expedia bookings via UOB PRVI Miles website! Or earn 3 miles per S$1 spent on regional spend in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, 2.4 miles on other overseas spend and 1.4 miles for local spending. With no annual fee for the first year, maximize your rewards and make every trip unforgettable. Enjoy exclusive travel perks like complimentary travel insurance and lounge visits!

our_takes.our-take: The UOB PRVI Miles Visa excels for frequent regional travellers, offering 3 miles per S$1 on spending in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, including online shopping. You also get complimentary lounge access. Maximize value by booking stays through Agoda or Expedia via UOB's site for up to 8 miles per S$1. While versatile for general use with no minimum spend or miles cap, the 3.25% foreign transaction fee warrants consideration. Consider pairing with a KrisFlyer UOB account to potentially boost miles further.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travelers who want to earn miles quickly on overseas spending and redeem them for flights.
Cardholders who enjoy booking accommodations through Agoda and Expedia to maximize their miles earnings.
Singaporeans earning at least S$30,000 annually seeking a fuss-free rewards card for travel and local spending.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Late payments incur a S$100 fee monthly; consistently missing them adds 3% interest. Set reminders to avoid these costly penalties and higher interest.
3.25% foreign transaction fee applies; plus 1% if SGD transactions are processed overseas. Factor this into your travel budget to avoid surprises..
Cash advances have high fees (8%, min S$15) and 28.5% interest. Avoid using this feature due to its high cost compared to other options.
